scripts.harness: electron-vite build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs app --env WISP_HARNESS_MINUTES=10
scripts.harness:short: electron-vite build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs app --env WISP_HARNESS_MINUTES=1 --env WISP_SELFTEST=1
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --win
scripts.sprites: node scripts/make-placeholder-sprites.mjs && node scripts/make-docs-images.mjs && node scripts/make-docs-gifs.mjs
